text: The low reticulocyte count confirms a hypoproliferative anemia, consistent with physiologic anemia of prematurity rather than hemolysis or blood loss. The normal head ultrasound and neurological exam rule out intracranial hemorrhage or infection as the cause of apnea. Given the preterm status, low hemoglobin, and hypoproliferative state, I suspect the anemia is contributing to the apnea via decreased oxygen-carrying capacity.
